name: Realtime translation sessions
summary: Dedicated Realtime translation endpoints (`wss://.../v1/realtime/translations` + `POST /v1/realtime/translations/client_secrets|calls`); model is `gpt-realtime-translate`, passed as WebSocket query param or in `session.model`.
description: Realtime translation uses the dedicated Foundry OpenAI WebSocket translation endpoint (`wss://.../openai/v1/realtime/translations`) to stream speech into translated output. The model is `gpt-realtime-translate`, selected by the realtime session endpoint/configuration rather than a normal Responses-style model field.
notes: No BYOM probe is meaningful: the translation model is selected by the realtime translation endpoint/session, not by a top-level `model` field that can carry `{connection}/{deployment}`. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/openai/how-to/realtime-audio.
